changes.summary: Implemented the full-stack Bonos Totales module as the Sprint 17 replica of Depositos Totales.
code: Added backend/services/bonos-totales.service.js with upsert(), getPagedAndFiltered() and getLatest() using sheet bonos_totales and audit entity bono_total.
Added backend/controllers/bonos-totales.controller.js and backend/routes/bonos-totales.routes.js with verifyToken + requireAdmin on POST and GET.
Added backend/tests/bonos-totales.service.test.js covering create, overwrite, validation and latest selection.
Extended frontend/src/lib/api.ts with BonoTotalRecord, createBonoTotal and getBonosTotales.
Added the Bonos Totales sidebar entry for admin users.
Updated backend/package.json lint/test coverage to include the new files.
Extended backend/tests/auth-gate-routes.test.js to assert the new admin-only route.
